items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Was Lucille O'Shea taking any percentage of your money at this point? ... Yeah. Well, it was the original contract.

ctx.x: No. No. No. It was just between the two of us. It was an agreement we had with the office, you know. We probably got more money, but a certain amount of the monies was being sent to our families by Nat Nazarrax, see, because he was still managing us, you see. And the Chuck and Chuckles.
Was Lucille O'Shea taking any percentage of your money at this point?

Yeah. Well, it was the original contract. The contract was for life, see. That's why I say that we were probably making more money, but some of the money was going towards the contract and our families.
